name: Temple of Embers
checks: every crate stands on authored floor
no rail passes through a crate
crates stand inside a flame sweep only on purpose
no hazard stands in scenery and no scenery stands on a pedestal
no crate inside a censer swing
no crate inside a patrol walk
checkpoints respawn ten metres clear of flames, nitro, patrols and swings, on floors six metres deep
volatile crates keep their blast away from boxes that are not meant to pay out
platforming gaps are within a single jump and ledges within a jump's height
no crate stands on a stepping stone (ledges and plinths under six metres deep)
clusters, not sprinkles: mean cluster size at least 2.5 and singles at most a fifth of counted crates
every section carries eight to twenty-four counted crates, except the declared timing peak of the abutment
outline crates belong to the cornice switch group alone, and that group has exactly one switch
every arrow has a target that only its bounce reaches
a board charge gap has thirty clear metres of run-up and a checkpoint one beat before it

rooms.name: Ravine floor
rooms.lesson: carve the crate line, take the mask, read the sleeping flame, meet the crabs in the open

rooms.name: The Great Stair
rooms.lesson: TNT, arrow and double jump taught alone on the landing; six short hops with a rest; the fuse court tests them

rooms.name: The sluice
rooms.lesson: drop in, charge the descent, smash the three stacks, carry speed into the crossing

rooms.name: Broken aqueduct
rooms.lesson: ollie or grind the crate bridge; charge the Far Break; the colonnade on foot; cross the abutment in the cool phase

rooms.name: The Cistern
rooms.lesson: cross the basin at speed or climb the cornice to the switch; the block it fills waits on the hall floor; time the exit under the niche sentinel

rooms.name: Sanctuary steps
rooms.lesson: four jumps up over the drain; the bristleback on the second step punishes a stomp

rooms.name: Sanctuary terrace
rooms.lesson: hold cruise through the wave, launch onto the dais, drop straight between the Nitro rows, spend the height budget once, hit the green switch last
